info.name: Luxe Salon OS API
info.description: REST API for salon client, staff and owner apps. Identify the salon with the X-Tenant header (salon slug) or call the salon domain. Authenticate clients with phone OTP to receive a Bearer token.

item.name: AI Studio
item.description:
Virtual try-on for the client app. Same safety gates as the website (consent, minors, moderation, client quota,
salon credit wallet) because every job goes through RequestTryOn. Photos are encrypted at rest and only served
through short-lived signed URLs on the salon's own domain.

request.description: Signed-in clients also get their remaining tries and consent state in `meta`.

item.name: Look photo (signed URL from the job / look payload).

request.description: Required once (per consent version) before the first try-on; `adult=false` blocks face styles.

formdata.description: Age confirmation for the inline consent.

request.description:
Multipart upload. Poll GET /studio/jobs/{id} until `status` is succeeded or failed. Credits are charged
only when the look succeeds. `consent`/`adult` may be sent here instead of calling POST /studio/consent.

item.name: Save a look (kept until deleted instead of expiring with the retention window).
Delete a look and its photos.
Authentication
item.description:
Clients sign in with a one-time code sent by WhatsApp/SMS and receive a Sanctum token.
Send `X-Tenant: {salon-slug}` (or call the salon's own domain).

request.description: The App Review phone (salon settings `api.review_phone` / `api.review_code`) gets no message: its fixed code works.

item.name: Verify the code and receive an API token.
Booking
item.description:
Availability, booking, payment hand-off, cancel and reschedule for the client app. Every write goes through
the same Booking Actions as the salon website (HoldSlot → CreateBooking → StartBookingPayment), so the same
domain events fire and the same rules apply.

query.description: Service ids, booked back-to-back in this order.
Preferred stylist for every service (omit = no preference).

request.description:
Slots are grouped by part of day in the branch timezone; `starts_at` is UTC and must be posted back unchanged.
When the day is empty `next_available_date` points to the next date with a free slot.

item.name: Hold a time while the client reviews.

request.description: Optional: POST /bookings holds the time itself. Returns the totals and the payment options the client may pick.

Holds the slot (unless `hold_token` is given) and creates the booking. With `payment_preference` deposit|full
the booking is `pending_payment` and `payment.checkout_url` is the hosted payment page; the booking is
confirmed by the payment webhook. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: retries replay the first response.

item.name: Times to move a booking to (the booking's own time does not block).

request.description: Inside the cancellation window the late-cancel fee is kept and the rest of any online payment is refunded.

item.name: Owner app
item.description:
Today's KPIs per branch, alerts and quick campaigns. Branch restrictions of the member apply; KPIs need
reports.view (revenue figures reports.revenue), campaigns marketing.send.

query.description: Omit for all branches the member can see.

request.description:
Sends a short message now to a saved segment through the Marketing module (consent, quiet hours and message
credits apply exactly as for dashboard campaigns). Send an Idempotency-Key.

item.name: Packages, notifications & referrals
item.description:
Session packages / bundles (Marketing module), push device registration, the client's campaign inbox and
referral share info.

item.name: Shop
item.description:
Mobile app shop API (/api/v1/shop/...). Cart is identified by the X-Cart-Token header
(returned by every cart response); client endpoints use Sanctum tokens. Orders are placed with the same
PlaceOrder action as the website checkout.

item.name: Product detail by slug (or numeric id).
One of my orders by number (SO-10001).

request.description:
Uses the X-Cart-Token cart, or builds one from `items` (the app keeps its cart locally). With
`payment_method=online` the response carries `checkout_url` (hosted payment page). Send an Idempotency-Key.

item.name: Staff & owner authentication
item.description:
Team members sign in with their dashboard e-mail and password. When app MFA (authenticator) is enabled on the
account, the first attempt answers 422 with `error.code = mfa_required`; repeat with `code`. Tokens carry the
ability of the app (`staff` or `owner`) and only work on that app's endpoints, for this salon.

item.name: Revoke the current staff / owner token.
Revoke the current staff / owner token.
Staff app
item.description:
The signed-in stylist's day, check-in, commissions, time off and client cards. Branch restrictions of the
team member apply (same as the dashboard); bookings are shown in each branch's timezone.

request.description:
One entry per booking with my services of that day (branch-local date). Client notes / allergies need
clients.view; first-visit flag from the client's visit count.

query.description: Default: first day of this month.

request.description: Same numbers as the dashboard payroll report (BuildCommissionReport); refunds reverse in the period they happen.

Needs clients.view. Stylists limited to their own appointments (bookings.own_only) only see their clients.
Private notes need clients.private_notes.
Creates a pending request the owner approves in the dashboard.
Allowed for my own appointments, or for anyone with bookings.manage (reception).
